title: Microsoft SharePoint — lists and documents
author: Atlas core
description: Create, read, update, delete and find the items of a SharePoint list, and upload, download and check files in a document library, list a folder, create one or delete one — through a server-registered Microsoft Graph provider. The operation, the site, the list or library and the values are authored in the model; the Graph base and the OAuth credential (a client secret or a certificate) live on the server, resolved from the vault (ADR-0141, amended). Column values keep the type of their FEEL value, so a number, a Yes/No and a multi-choice column each receive what they read. A file's content travels through a process variable and is capped at 1 MiB; a larger document is handed to a person by its webUrl. The package id keeps the name it had when creating an item was the only operation, because installations refer to it by that id.

properties.label: Worker
properties.description: Name of the configured SharePoint Worker (Console → Workers), never a credential. The attribute behind this field is spelled connector for compatibility with models already deployed.

properties.label: Operation
properties.description: Empty is Create list item, which is what every task authored before operations existed does.

properties.label: Site
properties.description: The site as the browser shows it (https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/hr), as contoso.sharepoint.com:/sites/hr, or by Graph's site id. The site itself, not a page or a list in it.

properties.label: List or library
properties.description: The list an item operation acts on, by title or id. For a file operation, the document library; empty there means the site's default library.

properties.label: Item id (Read/Update/Delete list item)
properties.description: The list item's id — usually from an earlier step, e.g. =angelegt.id after Create list item.

properties.label: Path (file operations)
properties.description: The file or folder from the library's top level, e.g. Akten/4711/antrag.pdf. An upload to a path that exists replaces the file, which the library keeps as a version.

properties.label: Content (Upload file)
properties.description: What to store. It travels through a process variable, so it is capped at 1 MiB.

properties.label: Content is (Upload/Download file)

choices.name: Text — the characters as they are
Base64 — a binary file, e.g. a PDF

properties.description: Text is right for JSON, CSV, XML and a letter. Base64 is what a binary needs to survive a process variable, and what a form's uploaded file already is.

properties.label: Filter (Find list items)
properties.description: An OData filter over the columns, e.g. fields/Status eq 'Offen'.

properties.label: Columns to read (Read/Find list items)
properties.description: The columns' internal names, separated by commas. Empty reads every column.

properties.label: Continue from (Find list items / List folder)
properties.description: The nextPageToken an earlier page answered with, passed back unchanged.

properties.label: Page size (Find list items / List folder)
properties.description: How many entries one page holds. Empty uses 100; at most 999.

properties.label: Result variable
properties.description: Receives what Graph answered: an item with its columns under fields, a page with items, hasMore and nextPageToken, a file with webUrl and its properties under listItem.fields, a download with content, or deleted / exists / created flags. Column values themselves are set as itemField children in the Modeler's Columns table.
